caption:
HEALTHY CHICKEN TIKKA RECIPE

- 450 grams chicken breast, boneless
- 3 tbsp thick curd (hung curd works better as it clings to the chicken and has a lower moisture content) 
- 2 tsp red chilli powder
- 1 tsp turmeric powder
- 1 tsp coriander powder
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste
- 1 tsp garam masala
- 1 capsicum, cut into squares
- 1 onion cut into squares
- 1 - 2 tomatoes, deseeded then cut into squares

Method: 
- add the dahi to a bowl and mix well
- add in all your spices 
- mix together then add in the chicken 
- coat the chicken completely and cover
- marinate for 30 minutes - 2 hours in the fridge 
- preheat your oven to 220 degrees
- add the chicken pieces to your rotisserie and place in the oven on the attachment
- if you do not have the option in your oven, standard satay sticks / metal skewers will do the trick ( remember to turn the skewers every 8 minutes for equal browning)
- the baking should take between 20 minutes - 30 minutes depending on the thickness of your chicken
- serve with pudina chutney and enjoy it fresh and hot :)
